item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Definition of innovative agronomic protocols for the productive and qualitative enhancement of durum wheat in Southern Italy (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-02 Agronomia e sistemi colturali erbacei e ortofloricoli

The project involves the development and validation of innovative agronomic protocols for the valorization of durum wheat. The strategies adopted will include the use of new generation biostimulants (both microbial and non-microbial), with the aim of reducing chemical inputs and promoting environmental sustainability. The effectiveness of these approaches will be evaluated in the field through the monitoring of the physiological and production parameters of the crop. Finally, the environmental impact of the proposed methods will be quantified through the Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodology

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia

The research activity, carried out within the framework of the MUR FIS 3 – BACH project dedicated to the study of biotremology applied to cultural heritage conservation, will focus on the study of multimodal communication in the behavioral ecology of two key cultural heritage pests: Anobium punctatum and Tineola bisselliella. Specifically, the candidate will be responsible for the development and optimization of innovative, multidisciplinary experimental setups dedicated to integrating chemical and vibrational communication in reproductive and aggregation contexts. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Study of microbial populations in food and agro-environmental matrices. (Politecnica MARCHE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-08 Microbiologia agraria, alimentare e ambientale

The research activity will focus on microbial populations associated with food and agro-environmental matrices using culture-dependent and -independent approaches. Main microbial groups will be quantified using conventional microbiological techniques and selective and/or differential media. Microorganisms of interest will be isolated, purified, identified, and preserved for phenotypic and functional characterization. DNA extracted directly from the matrices will be used for metataxonomic analyses targeting the 16S rRNA and ITS/26S rRNA genes. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: SUS-ATI - Sustainable use of wheat ATI diversity for healthier, low-impact food supply chains. (Politecnica MARCHE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The research programme aims to investigate and valorise the genetic and functional diversity of alpha-amylase/trypsin inhibitors (ATIs) in wheat to develop healthier and more sustainable varieties and food products. The activities will include the genomic characterisation of a broad panel of *Triticum* genotypes through targeted long-read sequencing, analysis of variation at ATI loci, and integration of genomic data with information on ATI content and immunostimulatory potential. Low-ATI wheat lines will be selected and evaluated, and strategies will be developed to valorise milling by-products, such as bran and germ, through controlled fermentation with lactic acid bacteria. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The research programme aims to investigate, characterise and valorise the genetic and phenotypic diversity of plant materials of agricultural interest within the framework of the inSiEME and Root2Res projects. The activities will include the collection, organisation, analysis and integration of genetic, genomic, phenotypic and environmental data obtained from plant materials evaluated under field and/or controlled conditions. Particular attention will be given to the relationships between genetic variation, agronomically relevant traits and responses to different environments, with the aim of identifying plant materials, information and tools useful for selection and crop breeding. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: . (Politecnica MARCHE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

The project involves activities related to the various stages of the strawberry breeding program, from the selection and implementation of crossing combinations to selection techniques and phenotypic evaluation of seedlings and selections obtained for yield, resistance to biotic and abiotic factors, and sensory and nutritional quality analysis. The research program also requires expertise in crop management, various phenotyping methodologies, and fruit quality control, as well as strawberry propagation techniques, including in vitro methods. Expertise in the analysis of data obtained from phenotyping and genotyping studies is also considered relevant.

item.description:

Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia
